issue: Completed acknowledgement remains visible in installed My list after last task completion
rootCause: Completion expiry was appended to WindowProvider, which never displays the acknowledgement. ListProvider, which displays it, scheduled only ordinary list transitions.
fix: Independently owned My list providers now use completionTimelineDates: retain list day/clock transitions and add the visible account/list-scoped acknowledgement expiry. Remove the unused acknowledgement expiry from A small window.

newTests: Last-task feedback has an expiry entry and becomes invisible exactly at the boundary; ordinary list transitions remain
Wrong account/list, unselected list, future feedback and already elapsed feedback do not add an expiry entry
